page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of HDD storage. This high-density local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating large-scale data transfers. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is its reliance on traditional HDD local storage rather than solid-state drives, which limits random read and write performance but offers high capacity. The Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU represents an older processor generation without hyperthreading. This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring massive storage capacity and sequential data access, such as big data processing, log analysis, data warehousing, and large-scale distributed file systems.
